## TL;DR

This unlisted reference and interactive sandbox showcases our **5 blog post archetypes** and component library (analytical mathematical curves, theme-aware SVGs, Mermaid pipelines, interactive sliders, and collapsible code blocks). It is maintained for testing and visual verification across different screen sizes and dark/light themes.
:::

## The 5 Blog Post Archetypes

To maintain varied reader engagement, blog posts rotate across 5 distinct structural archetypes:

```{mermaid}
graph TD
    Root["5 Editorial Post Archetypes"]
    
    Root --> T1["1. Empirical Benchmark & Algorithmic Deep-Dive<br/>(ML, Time-Series, Optimization)"]
    Root --> T2["2. Scientific Discovery & Earth System Impact<br/>(Atmospheric Chemistry, Climate, Health)"]
    Root --> T3["3. Intuitive First-Principles Explainer<br/>(Physics, Acoustics, Thermodynamics, Biology)"]
    Root --> T4["4. Developer Tooling & Practical Case Study<br/>(IDE Superpowers, Agent Harnesses, Debugging)"]
    Root --> T5["5. Interactive Geospatial & Data Science Tutorial<br/>(NetCDF, GeoPandas, Xarray, R Pipelines)"]

    class Root indigo
    class T1 plum
    class T2 olive
    class T3 sage
    class T4 ochre
    class T5 terracotta
    classDef indigo fill:#1d4a62,stroke:#c97d62,stroke-width:1.5px,color:#ffffff
    classDef plum fill:#48304a,stroke:#c97d62,stroke-width:1.5px,color:#ffffff
    classDef olive fill:#5b6e34,stroke:#c97d62,stroke-width:1.5px,color:#ffffff
    classDef ochre fill:#d69a2e,stroke:#3b1a18,stroke-width:1.5px,color:#3b1a18

```

## Visual Component Demonstrations

### 1. Analytical Mathematical Curves *(100% Exact Physics)*

$$U_{\text{eff}}(r) = -\frac{GMm}{r} + \frac{L^2}{2mr^2}$$

```{=html}
<div style="background: var(--md-code-bg-color, #1e293b); border: 1px solid #334155; border-radius: 12px; padding: 18px; margin: 20px 0; color: #f8fafc; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;">
  <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 12px;">
    <span style="font-weight: 600; color: #38bdf8;">⚡ Live Analytical Potential Curve & Classical Turning Points</span>
    <span style="font-size: 0.8em; color: #94a3b8;">r ∈ [0.4, 5.0] AU</span>
  </div>

  <canvas id="showcase-curve-canvas" width="680" height="220" style="width: 100%; height: auto; background: #020617; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #1e293b; display: block;"></canvas>
</div>
```


```{=html}
<script>
function drawShowcaseCurve() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('showcase-curve-canvas');
  if (!canvas) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

  const padLeft = 50, padRight = 20, padTop = 20, padBottom = 30;
  const w = canvas.width - padLeft - padRight;
  const h = canvas.height - padTop - padBottom;

  const rMin = 0.4, rMax = 5.0;
  const uMin = -1.2, uMax = 0.5;

  const toX = (r) => padLeft + ((r - rMin) / (rMax - rMin)) * w;
  const toY = (u) => padTop + ((uMax - u) / (uMax - uMin)) * h;

  // Zero Line
  const y0 = toY(0);
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#475569';
  ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(padLeft, y0); ctx.lineTo(padLeft + w, y0); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#94a3b8'; ctx.font = '10px system-ui'; ctx.fillText('E = 0 (Escape)', padLeft + w - 80, y0 - 4);

  // Effective Potential Curve
  const L = 1.1;
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#38bdf8';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  let first = true;
  for (let r = rMin; r <= rMax; r += 0.05) {
    const u = - 1.0 / r + (L * L) / (2 * r * r);
    if (u <= uMax && u >= uMin) {
      const px = toX(r), py = toY(u);
      if (first) { ctx.moveTo(px, py); first = false; } else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
    }
  }
  ctx.stroke();

  // Bound State Energy Level
  const E = -0.28;
  const yE = toY(E);
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#f59e0b';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(toX(0.74), yE); ctx.lineTo(toX(2.83), yE); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f59e0b'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(toX(0.74), yE, 4, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(toX(2.83), yE, 4, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillText('Bound Orbit (E = -0.28)', toX(1.3), yE - 6);
}
window.addEventListener('load', drawShowcaseCurve);
if (typeof document$ !== 'undefined') document$.subscribe(drawShowcaseCurve);
setTimeout(drawShowcaseCurve, 250);
</script>
```

### 3. Collapsible Code Blocks (`pymdownx.details`)

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## View Python Data Processing Module (`compute_statistics.py`)

```python
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def process_time_series(df: pd.DataFrame, target_col: str, window: int = 14) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Computes rolling statistics and exponential weighting on time series.
    """
    df = df.copy()
    df['rolling_mean'] = df[target_col].rolling(window=window, min_periods=1).mean()
    df['rolling_std'] = df[target_col].rolling(window=window, min_periods=1).std().fillna(0)
    df['ewma'] = df[target_col].ewm(span=window).mean()
    return df
```
:::
